formalism.name: Huxley-Thompson relative growth / allometry
formalism.differential_rates: dy/dt = alpha * y, dx/dt = beta * x with constant specific rates alpha, beta
formalism.allometric_law: y = b * x^k where k = alpha / beta (Huxley 1932)

state_variables.x: reference body size or length (g, cm, mm)
state_variables.y: organ or part size (same units or mass)

parameter_regimes.interpretation: brain grows slower than body (negative allometry of brain:body ratio)
heart nearly isometric with body mass

boundary_conditions.x_min: smallest tabulated specimen in each series

empirical_claims: Organ proportions are not fixed; they follow straight lines on log-log plots (definite relative rates).
Different organs yield different slopes k (differential growth).
Plaice weight-length curvature reflects cubic volume growth.
